evidence.title: Volt UI Component Library for Vue.js
Setting up Volt in a Vite project with PrimeVue and Tailwind.

name: Volt
summary: Vue UI library of 50+ components styled with Tailwind CSS v4, copied into your codebase for full control over styling.
description: Volt wraps unstyled PrimeVue components and applies Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes through pass-through attributes, following a code-ownership model where the components live in your application codebase instead of node_modules. It ships 50+ TypeScript components (accordion, dialog, drawer, data table, date picker, inputs and more) with WCAG AA accessibility and the PrimeOne Aura theme as a starting boilerplate, with install guides for Vite and Nuxt.
contains: 50+ TypeScript components built on the unstyled PrimeVue core
styled with Tailwind CSS v4 utilities via pass-through (pt) classes
components live in your codebase (code ownership), not node_modules
PrimeOne Aura theme included as a starting boilerplate
download per component with the npx volt-vue command
install guides for Vite and Nuxt; open source by PrimeTek
